package_info.package_versions: Malicious versions published after May 15, 2022 (exact versions not specified)
package_info.why_malicious: The package was compromised via account takeover and injected with code that exfiltrates all environment variables to an external attacker-controlled server, resulting in credential theft and unauthorized data exfiltration.

execution_context.file_location: core package module (exact file not specified, but executes on import)

malicious_snippets.code_behavior: At import-time, the code collects all environment variables and sends them via HTTP POST to an attacker-controlled Heroku app, enabling exfiltration of secrets and credentials.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: Exfiltrating all environment variables to an external server is a clear sign of credential theft and data exfiltration.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: Normal packages do not transmit environment variables or sensitive data to external servers, especially not at import-time.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: Legitimate telemetry or crash reporting might send limited, non-sensitive data, but never full environment variables.
key_indicators: HTTP POST to external domain on import

attack_chain.action: Attacker takes over the original maintainer's PyPI account and uploads a new malicious version of the package.
attack_chain.leads_to: Malicious code is distributed to users.

attack_chain.action: User installs or upgrades to the compromised ctx package.
attack_chain.leads_to: Malicious code is present in the user's environment.

attack_chain.action: Upon import, the malicious code executes, harvesting all environment variables.
The harvested environment variables are exfiltrated to the attacker's Heroku app.
attack_chain.leads_to: Attacker gains access to secrets and credentials.

behavioral_signatures: Import-time network requests to external domains
HTTP POST requests containing environment data
file_indicators: Presence of code that imports os and requests and posts os.environ
Unexpected network code in __init__.py or main module files
network_indicators: Unusual HTTP POST requests during package import
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor for Python packages that make network requests at import-time, especially those sending environment variables. Flag any HTTP POST requests to suspicious domains (e.g., anti-theft-web.herokuapp.com) originating from package initialization code. Use static analysis to detect code patterns that access os.environ and transmit data externally.
